headline: Approved $2500.00 Evergreen and $2000.00 Edgewood paving by Crisp Contracting, added paving, and 12-inch gravel base for new road.
summary: The Turnstone team reported that fencing will arrive Friday and demolition is slated to start on Monday 11/2. Approved items cover geotech testing by SW Cole, added paving and gravel for a new road, paving at Evergreen and Edgewood, and change order approval limits.
decisions: Approved the previous meeting notes of August 26, 2026, by a passed motion.
Approved the recommendation to use SW Cole for geotech testing services at the prices presented or below, subject to Carl A and Ken calling SW Cole to try to reduce pricing, by a passed motion.
Approved giving Ken L authority to sign off on subcontractors, by a passed motion.
Approved additional paving at Alt #1 locations and the option of 12-inch gravel and 2 1/2-inch pavement for the new road, by a passed motion.
Approved Crisp Contracting paving at Evergreen for $2500.00 and at Edgewood for $2000.00, paid from the Whitman Fund and Jackman Fund, by a passed motion.
Approved change order limits: Ken L up to $5,000.00, and Tom Dion or Brian Morrissey up to $50,000.00, by a passed motion.

plain_text:
Edgewood Cemetery Trustee’s Meeting 
October 28, 2026 
 
In Attendance: 
• Morgan Hollis (Vice Chairman) 
• Doug Gagne 
• Andrew Armstrong 
• Mike Lozeau 
• Bob McIntosh 
• Carl Andrade 
• Tom Dion 
• Ken Lennox (Superintendent) 
• Stacey Clark - Turnstone (Guest) 
• Tony DaCosta- Turnstone (Guest) 
• Jeff Comeau- Turnstone (Guest) 
• Aaron Giles- Turnstone (Guest) 
• Tyler Simmons -Randall-Paulson (Guest) 
• Caroline Morel – Randall-Paulson (Guest) 
 
 
3:30pm Vice Chairman Morgan Hollis—Calls the meeting to order.  
Carl A. - Motion to accept previous meeting notes of August 26, 2026. 
2nd by Doug G. to accept meeting notes of August 26, 2026.     Motion Passed. 
Ken Lennox presents “Notice of Meeting” to Morgan Hollis (Vice Chairman). 
 
3:32pm The Turnstone team is here to discuss the new building timeline, plans and budget.  
 
Aaron G. informs the Trustees that the fencing for the building will arrive Friday and demolition is 
slated to start on Monday 11/2.   The abatement work has been completed.   
 
Trailers are all installed and work fine for both the office/breakroom and storage.  
 
Tony D. speaks to the Trustees about the leveling sheets.  How to read them and what they are for 
and when we will receive them. 
 
The first Leveling sheet we received is for Geo Tech Testing Services.  This will be a direct relationship 
with the Cemetery.  Turnstone has recommended SW Cole for these services.   
 
Andy A. motions to accept the recommendation to go with SW Cole at the prices presented or below 
subject to Carl A and Ken calling SW Cole to try and reduce some of the pricing.     
2nd by Carl A.    
Motion Passed.
Morgan proposes to give Ken L the proper authority to sign off on recommended subcontractors. 
 
Carl A. motions to allow Ken L to sign off on subcontractors. 
2nd by Andy A.    
Motion Passed. 
 
Tony D. goes over budget with the Trustees.  He addresses any area that either went up or down on 
price.   
We discussed the paving.  The Trustees agree to add the 2 Alternative Add locations for paving near 
the new parking area and near the circle North of the Greenhouse.  
The team also discusses the thickness of the Gravel and Paving of the new road.  The team decides 
to go with 12” of Gravel and 2 ½ inches of Paving. 
 
Doug G motions to do the additional areas of paving (reference Alt #1 on budget sheet) and the 
Option of 12” of Gravel and 2 ½” of Pavement (reference Alt #1A and 1B on budget sheet) 
 
2nd by Carl A.   
Motion Passed. 
 
4:10pm Ken L. discusses paving areas at both Evergreen ($2500) and Edgewood ($2000).  Crisp 
contracting is the preferred bidder.   
 
Carl A. motions to have Crisp Contracting pave areas at Evergreen for $2500.00 and at Edgewood for 
$2000.00 to be taken out of the Whitman Fund and Jackman Fund respectively. 
2nd by Andy A.    
Motion Passed.     
4:28pm Tom D. leaves the meeting. 
 
Morgan discusses having members of the team to be authorized to sign Change Order Forms. 
 
Andy A. motions to have Ken L. approve any Change Order up to $5,000.00 and Tom Dion or Brian 
Morrissey up to $50,000.00. 
2nd by Carl A.   
Motion Passed.   
 
4:36pm Andy A. leaves the meeting. 
 
4:45pm Carl A. motions to adjourn. 
2nd by Doug G. 
Motion Passed.     
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Tom Dion (Secretary)
